WOODWORK — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.

4. When learning Framed Wooden Doors and Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

5. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.

6. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

8. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.

9. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.

10. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

11. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.

12. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.

13. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.

14. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Furniture Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Framed Wooden Doors and Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
